title: Basin imperial-remnant corridor-and-clearance skeleton
scope: Qualitative corridor-and-clearance skeleton of the withdrawn power's surviving physical works in and near the initial basin, with bounded condition classes and salvage as an activity class; usable for location, ecology, history, culture, and story development without establishing names, maps, positions, counts, engineering, ownership, law, institutions, story events, character knowledge, ancient-doorway facts, or any System-facing property.
claims: Physical remnants of the withdrawn power exist in and near the initial basin; present inhabitants generally recognise them as that power's work by workmanship, materials, and scale — cultural recognition, not accurate knowledge of any remnant's original function.

Organised ecological suppression left physical traces — cleared lines and ground works, qualitative kinds only; their regrowth is part of the basin's ordinary recovering mosaic, not a magical or System process.

No remnant functions as designed: up to roughly seventy years of decay, regrowth, frost, flood, and stripping, accumulating from each work's own local abandonment in the cascading retreat, have degraded every surviving work; partial incidental usefulness is the ceiling, no imperial work in or near the basin is continuously occupied since its abandonment, and reuse ranges from intermittent reclamation to sustained re-occupation of abandoned works, with the second settlement's industrial village nucleus (WLD-LOCATION-005) as the principal sustained instance.

No remnant grants working imperial machinery, intact knowledge stores, functioning mechanisms, or preserved archives by default; any exception is a new, separately argued proposal, never an implication.
Salvage of remnant materials is an activity class with finite, diminishing, contestable value; no salvage right, ownership, law, institution, market, price, or named practice is established.
All remnants are ordinary made things under ordinary physics and CAL0: no safe zone, spawn point, Mana source, System structure, doorway, or System-facing property of any kind.

The withdrawn power's dominant surviving signature is a decayed linear skeleton lattice across the lower basin and its approaches: engineered route segments and suppression clearances, with ruinous waystation-type and watch-type shells along both, scattered drainage and ground works, and occasional boundary and marker traces.

Present condition spans four qualitative classes: most of the skeleton is regrown, structure shells are ruinous, a few stretches or nodes are reused by present communities, and some stretches are avoided for practical reasons.
Legibility is partial: the pattern reads in stretches and is lost in others; no complete route or clearance line is known to survive.

Some regrown cleared ground qualitatively coincides with ground crown herds and travellers move through; no stretch is identified, no WLD-ECOLOGY-004 corridor or secondary path is located, and clearances are not claimed to cause or anchor route fidelity.
Whether the settlement's constructed road (WLD-LOCATION-001) reuses any imperial-era alignment or foundation is deliberately left open.
Salvage from the skeleton is dispersed and low-yield: worked stone and fittings from many small ruins — finite, diminishing, contestable; no right, law, market, or institution.

No remnant exists at the WLD-GEOGRAPHY-002 outlet reach, at the WLD-LOCATION-003 staging place or spurs, or in any WLD-LOCATION-001 settlement zone — the fortified core and its managed apron of warning belt, terraces, and fields-and-grazing shoulder; the constructed road corridor is expressly excluded from this bar and governed by the open road-derivation claim.

The imperial-remnant industrial village nucleus of the second settlement is an instance of this record's reused-node class; WLD-LOCATION-005 is the authority for everything about that settlement, and this record neither locates nor describes it beyond the class relationship.
boundaries: This record is a forward extension of the foundation capture's accepted retreat, withdrawn-suppression, and abandoned-clearance facts, not a retcon; it does not alter the basin frame, outlet sequence, ecological engines, migration relationships, settlement landscape, travel anchors, or shore-endpoint arrangement.

Skeleton, route segment, suppression clearance, waystation-type, watch-type, marker trace, node, reuse, avoidance, and salvage are author-facing qualitative labels fixing no in-world name, classification, measurement, count, position, standard, institution, entitlement, or guarantee; imperial is author-facing shorthand for the withdrawn power and fixes no in-world name.

No map, distance, direction, elevation, dimension, count, engineering quantity, or other quantitative geography is established; where any remnant lies relative to the settlement, road, lake, corridor, outlet, or any accepted feature remains undefined, and the stated qualitative exclusions are the only relational commitments.

Regrown, ruinous, reused, and avoided are condition classes only; no particular stretch, shell, or node is placed, counted, assigned a class, or guaranteed to persist, and class membership can change through ordinary processes.
Avoidance is practical — regrowth, flooding, or wildlife making a stretch worse than surrounding ground — not ritual, unless a later accepted culture record establishes otherwise.

Reuse means intermittent reclamation of abandoned works — travelling surviving firm stretches that serve current needs and quarrying shells for worked stone and fittings, as activity classes; no particular community, stretch, structure, practice, schedule, occupation, or event is established.

Regrown cleared lines are ordinary WLD-ECOLOGY-005 mosaic openings, browsed per WLD-ECOLOGY-001; no organism, reserve-web patch, or colony is placed in any remnant, and no remnant habitat becomes the basin's engine.

WLD-ECOLOGY-004's exact corridor geography and route-fidelity mechanism stay open; qualitative coincidence with regrown cleared ground identifies no stretch, locates no corridor or secondary path, and answers neither question.

WLD-LOCATION-002 remains the sole authority for its broad fair-weather whole-journey anchors; no remnant route segment creates a travel band, route, shortcut, or journey claim, and neither accepted anchor is divided, extended, shortened, or recalculated.

Salvage establishes no right, ownership, law, market, price, technique, party, season, yield, dispute, trade, or institution; salvage material is finite and diminishing, and nothing refills, resets, or preserves itself.

Decay, regrowth, frost, flood, and stripping are finite ordinary processes; construction detail — materials, styles, inscriptions, readability by any present person — and the local collapse chronology of abandonment order and timing remain open per WLD-HISTORY-001.

What each work was originally for, the accuracy of present beliefs about any remnant, and what records, traditions, or scholarly theories exist remain open; recognition of the builders is cultural belief about origin, not accurate knowledge of function, and no belief becomes fact by repetition.

The ancient archways or doorways are pre-imperial, separately parked, and constitution-protected; no remnant here is a doorway, doorway housing, or doorway-related work, and no claim touches their nature, builders, or operability.
The parked sapient pack species remains parked and unconnected to any remnant, gaining no biology, culture, or ability development.
No treasure inventory, cache, intact library, preserved archive, functioning mechanism, or working imperial machinery exists by default; any exception is a new, separately argued proposal.

No story event, character fact, plot use, or current-event claim beyond standing background texture is established; wildlife denning, ambush structure, salvage disputes, and unreliable regrown ground are implications requiring their own later records, not selected facts.

The skeleton is author-side spatial truth; a character knows a remnant, its condition class, its origin, or its salvage value only through an available source, and familiarity does not reveal hidden voids, buried works, concealed wildlife, past function, or a System value.

The cross-cite to WLD-LOCATION-005 establishes only that the second settlement's industrial village nucleus is an instance of the reused-node class; everything else about that settlement — position, layout, community, practice, history, and condition — is WLD-LOCATION-005's authority alone.

This record supplies only the basin-specific reused-works texture that WLD-HISTORY-001 defers to it; WLD-HISTORY-001's wider fragment-class option space, collapse chronology, and neighbor frame are untouched.
Ordinary finite land, matter, energy, labour, time, carriage, maintenance, obstruction, and recovery remain causal where later records establish them.

No safe zone, spawn point, dungeon, Mana source, System structure, readout, mechanic, movement effect, map revelation, free resource, guaranteed recovery, or CAL0 change is established; this is an ordinary setting extension under CAL0 WLD2.0D and WLD2.1A+D, and no WLD-SOUL, WLD-PRENATAL, or other project default is adopted.
story_implications: Later scenes may use decayed route stretches, regrown clearances, ruinous shells, reused nodes, and avoided ground as standing background texture, while every actual journey, find, dispute, encounter, and outcome requires its own evidence.
A finite dispersed salvage stream and contestable finds can motivate low-grade friction, but no dispute, party, practice, or event follows automatically.
Ruins and regrown ground can later carry denning, ambush, or unreliable-footing texture only through their own records.
Present recognition of the builders' work is cultural belief, not automatic character knowledge; what any character knows about a remnant requires an available source.
system_implications: The selected skeleton is ordinary world-level location input under CAL0 WLD2.0D and WLD2.1A+D, not a System change.
All remnants are ordinary made things under ordinary physics; decay, regrowth, stripping, and flooding are finite ordinary processes that do not refill, reset, or preserve themselves.
No safe zone, spawn point, dungeon, Mana source, System structure, doorway, readout, mechanic, movement effect, map revelation, free resource, or guaranteed recovery is established.
